# mux_playback_restriction (Resource)

A playback restriction: the referrer domains and user agents allowed to play videos whose signed playback token names the restriction's ID. Every change is made in place, so the ID, which tokens and applications refer to, never changes. Mux takes a few minutes to enforce a new list of domains.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "mux_playback_restriction" "web" {
  referrer = {
    allowed_domains = [
      "example.com",
      "*.example.com",
    ]
  }
}

# Native applications send no Referer header.
resource "mux_playback_restriction" "native" {
  referrer = {
    allowed_domains   = []
    allow_no_referrer = true
  }

  user_agent = {
    allow_high_risk_user_agent = false
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `referrer` (Attributes) Which referring domains may play the videos. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--referrer))

### Optional

- `deletion_protection` (Boolean) Refuse to delete or replace this object. Defaults to `true`, because deleting a restriction stops playback for every token that names it, and a new restriction gets a new ID. Apply `false` before destroying it.
- `user_agent` (Attributes) Which user agents may play the videos. Defaults to allowing all of them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--user_agent))

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) When the restriction was created, in seconds since the Unix epoch.
- `id` (String) Playback restriction ID, the `playback_restriction_id` claim of a signed playback token.

<a id="nestedatt--referrer"></a>
### Nested Schema for `referrer`

Required:

- `allowed_domains` (Set of String) Domains allowed to play the videos, at most 100. An entry is a domain (`example.com`), a wildcard for its subdomains (`*.example.com`) or `*` for any domain. An empty set denies every domain. The order does not matter.

Optional:

- `allow_no_referrer` (Boolean) Whether to allow requests without a `Referer` header, which is what native applications and smart TVs send. Defaults to `false`.


<a id="nestedatt--user_agent"></a>
### Nested Schema for `user_agent`

Optional:

- `allow_high_risk_user_agent` (Boolean) Whether to allow user agents Mux considers high risk. Defaults to `true`.
- `allow_no_user_agent` (Boolean) Whether to allow requests without a `User-Agent` header. Defaults to `true`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by playback restriction ID; data.mux_playback_restrictions lists them.
terraform import mux_playback_restriction.web 9dbEg8o00uqQzZbzJT6NXdqNA00SdnSo8O
```
